title: Cancellation Windows and Forfeit Shares by Programme
content:
# Cancellation Windows and Forfeit Shares by Programme

For a commission under Belrose Design Studio Custom Commissions, each programme fixes the calendar days after design approval within which the commission may be cancelled on the lighter forfeit, the share of the quoted total forfeited when the commission is cancelled before production begins, and the share forfeited when it is cancelled after production has begun.

## Schedule

| Programme | Cancellation window after design approval (calendar days) | Lighter forfeit share (before production) | Heavier forfeit share (after production has begun) |
|---|---|---|---|
| Design Studio Semi-Custom Setting | 3 | 10 per cent | 50 per cent |
| Design Studio Custom Setting | 5 | 15 per cent | 60 per cent |
| Belrose Bespoke Design | 7 | 20 per cent | 75 per cent |
| Belrose Bespoke Signature Commission | 10 | 25 per cent | 85 per cent |
| Belrose Heritage Redesign Commission | 7 | 20 per cent | 75 per cent |
| Belrose Atelier One-of-a-Kind Commission | 14 | 35 per cent | 100 per cent |

## Both sides of the schedule (hypothetical figures)

- A Belrose Heritage Redesign Commission quoted at USD 12000.00: the lighter share is 20 per cent, USD 2400.00; the heavier share is 75 per cent, USD 9000.00.
- A Belrose Atelier One-of-a-Kind Commission's heavier share is 100 per cent of the quoted total, and its lighter share 35 per cent.
- The Design Studio Semi-Custom Setting has the narrowest window, 3 calendar days; the Belrose Atelier One-of-a-Kind Commission the widest, 14.
